{{Quote|Okay, break time is over, get back to work!|The droid to two other droids|<ref name="Plan of Dissent">{{TCW|Plan of Dissent}}</ref>}}
A '''battle droid''' was stationed in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Unidentified Separatist supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] stationed over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]].

==Biography==
When the Separatist supply ship was infiltrated by three [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] flying captured [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] was speaking to two other droids, telling them that the break was over and to start working again. After the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] finished his sentence and walked away, he was hit by the wing of one of the commandeered starfighters and was destroyed.

==Behind the scenes==
The B1 battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
